DeviceToken.title: DeviceToken
DeviceToken.description: Private device registration storing a user's Android/Web FCM push token and standby state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the device owner.

fcmToken.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging device token (empty string if web-only without FCM).

standbyEnabled.description: Whether Mode Siaga latar belakang is active on this device.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when device record was first registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last device token/status refresh.

PeerDirectoryEntry.title: PeerDirectoryEntry
PeerDirectoryEntry.description: Public non-PII lookup mapping a 6-digit WattappsAU peer ID to its Firebase owner UID for wake signal routing.

peerId.description: 6-digit WattappsAU peer ID matching the document ID.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID that owns this 6-digit peer ID.

displayName.description: Display callsign shown for peer wake resolution.

pushReady.description: Whether the peer has an active native push token or wake listener.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when directory entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

WakeSignal.title: WakeSignal
WakeSignal.description: Queued wake/incoming-call/message notification signal delivered via Firestore realtime listeners or FCM triggers.

signalId.description: Unique signal ID matching the document ID.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the sender.

recipientUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the target recipient.

recipientPeerId.description: 6-digit WattappsAU ID of the target recipient.

callType.description: Call media type for INCOMING_CALL signals, or none for messages.

callId.description: Optional call correlation identifier (empty string if non-call).

status.description: Delivery lifecycle state; acknowledged is terminal.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when wake signal was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when wake signal was last updated.

/devices/{userId}.description: Private per-user device FCM token and Mode Siaga status document.

/peerDirectory/{peerId}.description: Single-document lookup mapping a 6-digit WattappsAU peer ID to its Firebase UID without exposing private tokens.

/wakeSignals/{signalId}.description: Realtime wake-signal and offline push notification queue between authenticated peers.
